commands.description: One entry per document command type the GUI sends, keyed by the type name in schemas/document-commands.schema.json. Not stored in contracts/edit-surface.json: scripts/check_capabilities_manifest.py builds it from the CommandSpec decisions in the document command registry and validates the result here.

mcp.description: Registered MCP tool names that perform this edit.

cli.description: `podcast ...` commands that perform this edit; each must resolve in the real Typer tree.

partial.description: True when mcp and cli are both set but one covers only some actions of the command; the stale-gap check is skipped.

gap.description: Allowed only while mcp or cli is empty, or with partial true. A gap on a fully covered type fails the check.

exempt.description: The GUI sends this type but it is not a project edit (read-only or session-only), so it needs no agent twin.

manifest_rows_without_cli.description: Project capability rows with a GUI surface and MCP but no CLI. Entries go away when the row gains a CLI entry.

manifest_rows_without_mcp.description: Project capability rows with a GUI surface and CLI but no MCP tool. Entries go away when the row gains an MCP tool.
